europe_now.title: Estonia Closes Russian Border Crossings Following Security Breach
europe_now.summary: Estonian authorities have announced the closure of Russian border crossings following a reported sabotage attempt at a drone factory. The incident highlights heightened security concerns across the region.

sources.headline: Estonia to close Russian border crossings after 'sabotage' attempt at drone factory

europe_now.title: Large-Scale Drone Attacks Reported Against Moscow
europe_now.summary: Numerous drone strikes targeted Moscow while a simultaneous strike on the Crimea bridge disrupted traffic. The escalating aerial operations mark a significant escalation in regional conflict impacts.

top_stories.title: Public Demonstrations Over Media Reforms in Czechia
top_stories.summary: Large crowds of protesters have gathered in Prague to demonstrate against proposed changes to public media funding. The contentious reforms have also prompted high-profile media figures to voice opposition and step down.

top_stories.title: European Nations Pursue External Migration Hubs
top_stories.summary: A group of European Union member states is finalizing an agreement with Rwanda to establish a migrant return and deportation centre. This collaborative initiative is part of broader efforts to manage external migration pressures.
